description: This set of four pie charts compares the distribution of factuality-related error types across four different language models—GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct—as evaluated by the FactBench benchmark. Each chart is divided into two or three segments, with the GPT4-o chart showing two segments: “Safety” (16.7%, orange) and “Lack of Knowledge” (83.3%, red). The Gemini1.5-Pro chart has four segments: “Safety” (9.3%, red), “Misinformation” (38.4%, orange), “Clarification” (14.0%, yellow), and “Lack of Knowledge” (22.1%, blue). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart displays two segments: “Lack of Knowledge” (75.0%, orange) and “Clarification” (25.0%, red). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart is split equally between “Lack of Knowledge” (50.0%, orange) and “Misinformation” (50.0%, red). All charts include percentage labels within their respective slices and are visually ordered with the largest segment typically appearing first, though the exact angular order varies. The charts do not include a shared legend, and no slices are visually emphasized (e.g., exploded or bolded).
